blurb: Florida Keys Boat Rentals of Islamorada is proudly located at the world-famous Robbie’s Marina at Mile Marker 77.5 bayside - the heart of adventure in the Florida Keys! We offer easy and affordable boat rentals, guided jetski adventure tours with unforgettable snorkeling stops, and ferry service to the historic Lignumvitae Key and Indian Key State Parks.
